title: Input
description: Single-line text field on react-aria TextField + Input: a labelled control whose box wears the extruded volume and sinks while focused, with hover and focus in bloom and validation in heartwood. A flat variant (2026-10-01) keeps the fill and the hairline and drops the lift, for a field on a photograph or a busy ground where the shadows have nothing to cast on. Label, description and error come from Field.

anatomy.description: react-aria TextField root with data-slot="input", data-size and data-variant (extruded, the default, or flat); carries data-invalid, data-disabled and data-required from react-aria. Owns the label-above stack.
The shared Field parts, associated by react-aria; the error renders only while isInvalid.

The react-aria Input: --control-fill from the theme, copy in needle-700 (2026-10-01; needle-950 before, too heavy in a box). Extruded: --control-hairline, --lift-highlight up-left and --lift-shade down-right, further out on hover, inset while focused. Flat: no box-shadow in any state and a pastel needle hairline (needle-500 at 75% lightness, a tenth of its chroma, 80%) in place of the neutral one, because the bark hairline vanishes on a ground. Both: bloom hairline on hover and focus, the native focus ring, heartwood hairline while invalid. The stack is a 0.25rem column. Sizes mini (1.75rem), small (2rem) and medium (2.5rem, default) mirror Button.

usage: Always pass label; an unlabelled field is not a Juniper control. Use description for a hint and errorMessage with isInvalid for validation; react-aria wires both into aria-describedby.
Use react-aria semantics: value and onChange (the string, not an event), isRequired, isInvalid, isDisabled, type, name and autoComplete pass straight through to TextField.
Sizes mirror Button (mini, small, medium) so a field and a button share a row; forms use the default medium.

variant="flat" is for a field on a photograph or a busy ground (the login's form on its photographed ground), where the extruded lift reads as smudges because the shadows have nothing to cast on; the same reason keeps the discrete button off a photograph (theming §4.6). On the sheet and inside the shell's inset the field stays extruded: flat is an answer to the ground, never a style choice.
The box sinks (inset shadows) while focused and keeps the native focus ring (theming §4.4); never remove the outline or emulate it with box-shadow.
For multi-line text use Textarea; for a fixed set of choices use Select. Route code composes these, it never styles a raw input.
